lines.n_hook: Freelance milestone payments have a silent failure mode: the work gets done... and then everyone waits on the client.
lines.n_criteria: D'accord starts before the work does — with pass-fail criteria both sides agree on.
lines.n_hold: The client's funds are held with PayPal up front. Authorized — not charged.
lines.n_submit: To get paid, the freelancer doesn't send an invoice. They submit evidence: the real pull request, C.I. results, a live URL.
lines.n_verify: Two Claude reviewers grade every criterion — an evaluator, and an adversarial skeptic hunting for mocks and stubs. Both have to agree.
lines.n_release: A pass signs an attestation that unlocks exactly one payout.
lines.n_paid: Capture the hold. Pay the freelancer's PayPal. Settled.
lines.n_threat: And hidden instructions in the submitted code? Caught — before a model ever grades them.
lines.n_outro: D'accord. Agreed. Verified. Settled. Built for the PayPal A.I. Hackathon.
